not_a_correction: both methods are valid; this records why the numbers differ
other_label_method: ~1 Hz flight.csv; track from consecutive lat/lon with a flat 111132 m/deg frame; rel-alt floor 30 m; steps >= 5 m
the_point: at a 100 m cruise floor B2's SOUTHBOUND bin keeps exactly 1 sample, so its north-minus-south is not quotable there; the paper therefore quotes the 30 m floor for the 180 deg cell and says so in the table note. Both methods agree on the verdict (+9.5..+9.9 vs an expected +10.0) and on the null axis (~0).
this_label_method: native-rate dataflash GPS.Spd minus interpolated ARSP.Airspeed; heading from GPS.GCrs; rel-alt floor swept (100 m and 30 m); no median quoted from fewer than 10 samples
